children: Canada leisure airline's Q3 revenue grew 3% yr/yr but missed analyst expectations
Q3 adjusted EBITDA turned negative, impacted by higher fuel costs and increased salaries
Company secured C$250 mln in additional government financing to support liquidity
Transat expects Q4 capacity to rise 2% year-on-year in available seat-miles
Company says Q4 load factors are 0.6 percentage points higher than last year to date
Transat says Q4 airline unit revenues (yield) remain broadly in line with last year
FUEL COSTS - Co said sustained higher fuel prices were the primary driver of lower profitability in Q3
COMPETITION & YIELDS - Intense competition limited ability to pass on higher fuel costs, resulting in softer yields and load factors
SALARY & ROUTE IMPACTS - Higher pilot salaries and lost revenue from suspended Cuba flights also weighed on results
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "sell" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the leisure & recreation peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Transat AT Inc is C$2.00, about 8.7% below its September 9 closing price of C$2.19
